command.capture_rule: FAILURE-CAPTURE FC-K2: stdout, stderr and the exit status go into fresh files beside the attempt, never inside it; each must be absent before the start. A redirect into the attempt would create it first and the observer would refuse (EVIDENCE-FRESH).
command.environment_note: No other variable. macOS may add __CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING when CoreFoundation loads (contract S10); the observer admits it and records its value in HOST. -B is on the command line because the environment admits no Python variable (MH-PLAN N-09).
command.note_on_argv: /usr/bin/env -i clears the inherited environment and executes the .venv's python with exactly the declared environment; env is replaced by the interpreter in the same process. The framework launcher then executes its Python.app image, as on every start of this interpreter; the observer checks sys.executable, the launcher and the process image (W3-OBSERVER section 1; check_launcher).
command.shell_form: cd <local>/c271-p35/evidence && /usr/bin/env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin LANG=C.UTF-8 LC_ALL=C.UTF-8 TZ=UTC UV_THREADPOOL_SIZE=2 <worktree>/.venv/bin/python -I -S -B <worktree>/prototypes/static_tray_v01/current_host_observation_v02.py observe --plan <local>/c271-p35/workers/W2-plan-001/observation-plan-001.json --plan-sha256 b8cd6449aba958373f68715158402ed2e0e233e08213f3521bbc3d80cfe4c152 > <local>/c271-p35/evidence/observe-001.observe.stdout.txt 2> <local>/c271-p35/evidence/observe-001.observe.stderr.txt; echo $? > <local>/c271-p35/evidence/observe-001.observe.exit.txt
